dsh-ikun-pet 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

posts.en:
dsh-ikun-pet is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. An ikun (basketball meme) pet that fills the dock under the "Deep diving..." status row during replies: a sprite-sheet pet walks a 0→100% progress bar, switching animation and text every 20%, and plays a system-level "nǐ gàn ma~" voice cue at completion.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9b97c27936425d56a79e.html
